notes.title: METAL SLUG XX RETURN TO THE MISSIONS! NEW PATCH AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
Hi Soldiers!

Thank you very much for playing METAL SLUG XX, and for your reviews of our latest release on Steam.

We are aware of the trouble that many of you have encountered during your game experience, and sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.

Our development staff is currently working hard on fixing the issues that have been described, and will update you here once the update is ready to be released.

Thank you very much for your kind patience and understanding! Stay tuned, Soldiers!

SNK CORPORATION

UPDATE:

Hi Soldiers!

We are pleased to announce that a new patch allowing you to choose between several screen resolutions, toggle between full screen and window mode display sizes and to configure your keyboard layout as well is now available on Steam!

Please make sure to update your game, share about your game experience, and to update your review to let us know how you liked those changes!!

Mission Start!!

SNK
